results.title: A write through a repository during a fold
results.evidence: refused with a bare RuntimeError carrying no code, no detail and no remediation, so `Routes.guard` cannot map it and a route reaching it answers 500. Latent rather than live: the folded tables are read by `WorkList.across` and the portfolio cuts, which write nothing, and the digest's `notification` writes land after the fold has closed — so no route reaches it today and the first one that does fin

results.title: A write during a fold that does not go through a repository
results.evidence: a raw UPDATE landed during a fold and the fold went on answering 'fold-7021119d' while the table said 'renamed by a raw statement'. `_refuse_write_while_folding` is called from `Repository.add/set/remove` only, so any write reaching the database another way is invisible to it and nothing is said

results.title: A fold, an inner fold, and the outer index
results.evidence: the inner fold is a no-op and the outer index survives it

results.title: A folded read with an `order` or a `limit`
results.evidence: 6 rows either way; ordered and limited reads fall through to SQL unchanged

results.title: A table outside the folded fourteen read during a fold
results.evidence: evidence_node is outside the fourteen and reads fresh: 14 → 15 during the fold

results.title: An append-only repository `set()` reaching HTTP
results.evidence: the repository refuses 'append_only' with a detail and a remediation, and neither half of the taxonomy receives it: NOT in STATUS, NOT caught by Routes.guard. It is a bare RuntimeError, so a route reaching it answers 500 with no code — the refusal was written for a mapping it was never added to. Latent: `EvidenceRepository` is the only AppendOnly subclass and nothing outside the tests calls its se

results.title: `recorded_at` moved on a node, chain unchanged
results.evidence: a node's `recorded_at` was moved by 9,999 seconds and the chain still verifies: the timestamp is outside the content hash, so WHEN a governance act was recorded can be rewritten with a single UPDATE while every verification reports the chain intact
